topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found that old envelope tucked away in the back of the closet, where sunlight never dares to peek. Just a crinkled piece of paper, but on it, her handwriting, as familiar as the sound of rain at night. A list. Not just any list, but a bucket list, and at the top, written with a flourish, “Travel the world with you.” I run my fingers over the words, feeling them more than reading them. Outside, the city hums, a relentless symphony of the living, while here, it’s just me and this list, a promise of adventures yet to unfold. I fold it back, carefully, like closing a window you don’t want to shut, and tuck it away, closer to me this time. Some things are worth keeping close, no matter what the world throws your way.
